BQK runs to 2026-07 while ATK ends 2025-12 — a 7 month lag. Integrated pages use the latest year both institutions cover, never a BQK month against an ATK month that does not exist.

The ASK municipality tables count enterprises registered or closed IN a quarter, not businesses trading at the end of one: Prishtinë runs 649, 766, 759, 749 … 1,599, 942 across consecutive quarters, which no stock does. They are summed over four quarters and reported as a year of formation. No terminals-per-business ratio is derived from them — doing so once gave 9,584 terminals per 1,000 enterprises.

ASK and ATK turnover shares agree to within 0.08 points across all 10 sections they share in 2023. The two land within 0.08 points of each other on every section. That is closer than two independent measurements of an economy ever come, so it is evidence of a shared source rather than of independent confirmation: ASK almost certainly compiles these statistics from the same tax records. Treat it as a check that both sides are processed consistently, not as a second opinion on the turnover itself.

The ASK and ATK turnover figures are not an independent pair. Agreement to 0.08 points on every section indicates ASK compiles its structural statistics from the same tax records, so this is not a second opinion on the penetration denominator. No public source measures Kosovo turnover independently of the tax administration, and the spine rests on ATK alone.
48,317 active enterprises in 2023 against 14,049 card-accepting merchants in 2026-07: at most 29.1% of the trading base can present a card, and at least 34,268 cannot.

Active enterprises end 2023 while merchants run to 2026-07 — a 3 year gap. The business base grew over those years, so the acceptance share is an upper bound and the number not accepting is a lower bound. It is reported as "fewer than", never as a point estimate.

The size split is of enterprises REGISTERED in the month, not of those already trading: the micro share moves between 98.6% and 99.8% month to month, which a base of fifty thousand businesses could not do. It describes who is registering now — 98.7% micro in 2026-07 — and is never read as the structure of the merchant base.

kpi_registry.business_definition: Terminal density against turnover in sectors where a card at a point of sale is a plausible payment method.

kpi_registry.denominator: Addressable turnover, MUNICIPALITY grain, analytical classification

kpi_registry.business_definition: Declared turnover divided by the registered taxpayer count.
kpi_registry.known_limitations: Taxpayers include entities with no turnover in the period.

kpi_registry.business_definition: Turnover in sectors classified as plausibly card-addressable. An analytical classification, not an official ATK metric.
kpi_registry.aggregation_rule: Sum of a flow within a classified subset
kpi_registry.valid_comparison_method: Year on year, same mapping version
kpi_registry.known_limitations: Reported as floor and ceiling because wholesale and retail are published as one section.

kpi_registry.business_definition: Each acquiring bank's share of POS terminals, transactions and value within the KBA reporting universe.
kpi_registry.aggregation_rule: Share within a single unlabelled period; never summed or trended
kpi_registry.valid_comparison_method: Between banks in the same extract only
kpi_registry.source_requirements: KBA bank reporting, supplied as an aggregate extract
kpi_registry.known_limitations: Supplied rather than downloaded, so there is no file hash. The extract carries no period label. Two banks report nothing and are excluded rather than counted as zero.

kpi_registry.business_definition: A bank's share of POS value divided by its share of POS terminals. Above 1 means each terminal carries more value than the market average, below 1 means less.
kpi_registry.aggregation_rule: Ratio of two shares within one extract
kpi_registry.valid_comparison_method: Between banks in the same extract only
kpi_registry.known_limitations: Identical to value per terminal indexed to the market, and factors exactly into transactions per terminal times average payment. Both factors are reported so the reason for a gap is visible. Says nothing about revenue: pricing is not published.

kpi_registry.business_definition: Card payments per POS terminal, for each acquiring bank.
kpi_registry.aggregation_rule: Ratio within one bank and one extract
kpi_registry.valid_comparison_method: Between banks in the same extract only
kpi_registry.known_limitations: Not comparable with the BQK per-terminal figures elsewhere in this report: those count a different transaction universe over a known period, this one an unlabelled span.
